title: 不要太想着去证明自己

coverage.asr_tail_excluded: S00026-S00027 extend past the audited media duration and are repeated outro recognition; they carry no semantic claim.

timeline.summary: A viewer asks whether confidence requires accepting fear; Mikey answers that one can accept the current fearful state and still act courageously.
He says rejecting fear and trying to prove one is not fearful can create self-conflict and intensify the problem.
He frames acceptance as allowing an existing state without surrendering action, so attention can return to doing what one judges correct; repeated ASR beyond the media boundary is excluded.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: Accepting that one currently feels afraid can coexist with choosing a courageous action.
claims.conditions: A general self-reflection answer, not clinical treatment advice.
